_kommentar: Hier kannst du alle FAQs bearbeiten. Einfach Fragen und Antworten ändern, hinzufügen oder entfernen.

faqs.frage: My background is not in business, can I still join?
faqs.antwort: Of course, our members come from a variety of fields, not just from business backgrounds.

faqs.frage: Do I have to have a startup to join?
faqs.antwort: No. You should have an intrinsic motivation towards entrepreneurship topics, a hands-on mentality and willingness to learn.

faqs.frage: I'm not a student in Maastricht, can I still join START Maastricht?
faqs.antwort: No, to become a member, you need to be a student enrolled in one of the universities in Maastricht. You are, however, very welcome to join one of our public events or collaborate with us.
We prioritize an active and lively community by organizing over 20 events and community meetups, as well as working in smaller groups on various projects.

faqs.frage: How can I benefit from joining START Maastricht?
faqs.antwort: You will get immersed into the entrepreneurship ecosystem, and find a community of like-minded, highly motivated and inspiring students that quickly become good friends. We have frequent event formats where you will gain new skills and insights and tackle hands-on challenges. As an active member you will join one of our departments, where you have additional opportunities to gain new skills and carry out projects.

faqs.frage: What are the tasks I have to do as a member?
faqs.antwort: You will choose one of our departments to become an active member and take on different projects. By doing this, you will have a chance to practice proactive project management and execution, and develop new department-specific hard skills like building automations, designing a marketing campaign, partner acquisition, event organization or recruiting of new members.
